text: Replaced the obsolete dense scaffold benchmark with the real streamed sparse cross-Gram path, including one-read relation blocks, retained local relations, coherent geometry, memory and block storage, cold/warm regimes, ready-file RSS measurement, Rprofmem telemetry, and named live temporaries. A 16 MiB trial was falsified; the explicit runtime/allocator reserve was calibrated to 64 MiB. Final versioned evidence covers all four scenarios: observed incremental peaks 25.5, 70.7, 45.9, and 32.3 MB versus plans 84.1-84.8 MB. Full tests and installed R CMD check are clean.
